connection.waitingDescription: Open ADOFAI and make sure the mod is enabled.
connection.updateDescription: Fully quit ADOFAI, then start it again to update TUFReplay.
connection.ipcUpdateDescription: The game is running an older or legacy AdofaiIPC than this website requires.
ipcUpdateSteps: Download the latest stable AdofaiIPC release.
Replace the installed AdofaiIPC files while ADOFAI is closed.
Restart ADOFAI, then retry the connection.
connection.clientUpdateDescription: AdofaiIPC is newer than the cached website client.
clientUpdateSteps: Refresh this page to load the latest website bundle.
If the message remains, clear this site's cache and reload.
updateSteps: Start ADOFAI again and wait for TUFReplay to update.
Return here; this page will retry automatically.
